title: Philipp Sauerland, Vanitas, 1000 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description In his painting Vanitas, Philipp Sauerland captured the essence of Baroque symbolism – a reflection on transience and the fleeting nature of worldly values. The motif has been faithfully recreated on a silver coin, with decoration that highlights every detail of the original. This edition enriches the series that brings the darkest masterpieces of world painting into contemporary numismatic art.
